templates.name: HP Milcy Turbo Stock Availability
templates.body: Dear {{name}}, fresh stock of HP Milcy Turbo 15W-40 (Heavy Duty Diesel Engine Oil) has arrived at Vikas Automobiles Satna warehouse. Special bundle discounts available on 20L and 50L packs for {{business}}. Reply ORDER to book your dispatch. - Vikas Automobiles (Ph: 9827003016)

templates.name: HP Racer 4 Bike Oil Promotion
templates.body: Namaste {{name}} ji, exclusive seasonal cash coupon coupons are now active on HP Racer 4 20W-40 for mechanics in {{city}}! Get instant scratch reward on every carton. Visit Vikas Automobiles or call 9827003016.

templates.name: Payment Reminder & Invoice Dispatch
templates.body: Dear {{name}}, greetings from Vikas Automobiles, Satna. Invoice for your recent HP Lubricants supply to {{business}} is ready. Kindly verify payment details with our accounts desk at 9827003016. Thank you for your continued partnership.

templates.name: New Product Launch - HP Neo Synth
templates.body: Introducing HP Neo Synth 5W-30 Fully Synthetic Engine Oil for modern BS6 cars! Available now at Vikas Automobiles Satna. Inquire today for introductory dealer margins for {{business}} in {{city}}. Contact: 9827003016.

templates.name: Dealership & Sub-Stockist Scheme
templates.body: Dear {{name}}, Vikas Automobiles (HP Lube C&F Agent, Satna) is announcing quarterly incentive schemes for automobile dealers in {{city}}. Reply DEALER to receive the scheme booklet directly on WhatsApp.

campaigns.name: Diwali HP Milcy Turbo Pre-Booking Scheme

autoReplies.title: General Greeting (HI / HELLO)
autoReplies.response: Hello! Welcome to Vikas Automobiles, Satna. We are authorized HP Lube Distributor & C&F Agent. How can we help you today? Reply PRICE for rates, CATALOGUE for product list, or LOCATION for warehouse address.

autoReplies.title: Price Inquiry (PRICE / RATE)
autoReplies.response: Please tell us which HP lubricant or product you require (e.g., HP Milcy Turbo 15W-40, HP Racer 4, HP Enklo 68, or Grease MP3) along with pack size so that our sales team can share the current wholesale price list.

autoReplies.title: Product Catalogue (CATALOGUE)
autoReplies.response: Thank you for your interest. We stock complete HP Automotive & Industrial lubricants: 1) Heavy Commercial & Tractor (Milcy Turbo), 2) Two-Wheeler (Racer 4), 3) Passenger Car (Neo Synth), 4) Industrial Hydraulics (Enklo 68). Our team will share the PDF brochure shortly.

autoReplies.title: Dealership Enquiry (DEALER)
autoReplies.response: Thank you for your dealership enquiry with Vikas Automobiles. Please share your business name, GST number, and shop location in MP. Our distributor manager will get in touch directly at 9827003016.

autoReplies.title: Office & Warehouse Location (LOCATION)
autoReplies.response: Vikas Automobiles, HP Lube Distributor & C&F Agent, Opp. Transport Nagar / Maihar Bypass, Rewa Road, Satna, Madhya Pradesh 485001. For dispatch inquiries contact: 9827003016.

autoReplies.title: Order Booking (ORDER)
autoReplies.response: Thank you for placing an order with Vikas Automobiles. Please reply with: 1) Product Name, 2) Pack Size & Quantity (e.g. 5x 20L Buckets), 3) Delivery City / Shop Name. We will confirm dispatch schedule.

autoReplies.title: Customer Support (SUPPORT)
autoReplies.response: Thank you for contacting Vikas Automobiles Support. Your inquiry has been logged and assigned to our Satna office team. For urgent matters, please call 9827003016.
